column1: Yandy Diaz leads the slate with a strong track record of consistency, hitting safely in over 71% of games and showing a recent uptick at the plate. Alec Burleson also stands out, riding a hot stretch and benefitting from the platoon advantage in a neutral park. Ernie Clement and Jonathan Aranda offer steady profiles, while Elly De La Cruz brings upside but less reliability. Diaz’s blend of contact skills and home park boost makes him the top pick today.
